18// This will default the version to 0.0.0 if not supplied by the Makefile. This will never
19// happen with our current Makefiles as the version gets baked into the command line in
20// the base build/common.mk but if this code is ever repurposed this will prevent a compile
21// error.
22#ifndef COMMON_VERSION
23#define COMMON_VERSION "0.0.0"
24#endif
25
26#ifndef COMMON_BUILD_DATE
27#define COMMON_BUILD_DATE "00/00/00--00:00"
28#endif
29
30#ifndef COMMON_REVISION
31#define COMMON_REVISION "INVALID"
32#endif
33
34// must be included once and only once in file with main()
35#define BEEROCKS_INIT_BEEROCKS_VERSION \
36 static beerocks::version s_beerocks_version(std::string(BEEROCKS_VERSION), \
37 std::string(BEEROCKS_BUILD_DATE), \
38 std::string(BEEROCKS_REVISION));
